name: Ritou
description: It is the area for central processing of all non-Inazuma nationals entering and leaving the nation. Before completing the Archon Quest Ritou Escape Plan, the Kanjou Commission Ashigaru will stop the Traveler from leaving Ritou on foot, barring access to the rest of Inazuma. After completing Ritou Escape Plan, the Traveler will be able to teleport out of Ritou to access other areas of Inazuma, but the Kanjou Commission guards will still prevent them from leaving on foot. After obtaining the Travel Permit from Kujou Kamaji in Chisato's Letter, the Traveler will finally be able to enter and leave Ritou without obstruction.
